{{nihongo|'''Fuhachimangu'''|府八幡宮}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Tōtōmi Province]].

=== Precinct buildings ===
* Main hall - built in Genna 3 (1617) in the Edo period. Three-bay {{ill|Nagare-zukuri|Q210684|qid=Q210684}}. Designated tangible cultural property of Iwata City.
* Worship hall and heiden - built in Kan'ei 12 (1635), Edo period. Designated tangible cultural property of Iwata City.
* Ch?mon gate - built in the Edo period. Designated tangible cultural property of Iwata City.
* R?mon gate - built in Kan'ei 12 (1635), Edo period. Designated tangible cultural property of Shizuoka Prefecture.
